create.name: Carrie Suwal
create.bio:
Carrie Suwal is an intuitive reader, channel and energy healer based in Canmore, in the Canadian Rockies, where she runs Healing Earth Therapy. She is a Reiki master and reads the Akashic records, and in sessions she works with what she describes as her team of spirit helpers to offer guidance and to clear and rebalance a person's energy field. She also holds a massage therapy diploma from the MH Vicars School and has more than a decade of practice as a professional intuitive. Her love of the mountains, the outdoors and animals runs through how she describes her work.

She sees clients in person in Canmore and at a distance, offering channelled readings, energy sessions, space clearing for homes and workplaces, and recorded meditations written for one person. For people building their own practice she runs a paid mentoring programme for lightworkers and sells a set of downloadable audio courses that move from a first level of energy healing through to setting up a professional offering, with further courses on channelling, past lives and working with the law of attraction. On Insight Timer she shares free guided meditations and talks alongside longer courses, and she is the author of the book Heal Using Intuition and Energy.

courses.title: Channeling/Energy Healing Session
courses.description: A one-to-one session in Canmore or by distance that combines channelled guidance with energy work, in whatever balance the client asks for. Questions can cover any area of life.

courses.title: Mentoring | Awakened Lightworker Support
courses.description: A mentoring programme for people developing their own intuitive or healing work, starting with four online one-to-one sessions and email support. Higher tiers add distance readings and her full course catalogue.

courses.title: Personalized Meditation Creation
courses.description: Carrie writes and records a guided meditation of five to twenty minutes for one person, after a video call about what they want from it. The script is shared for changes before recording, and the listener picks the music.

courses.title: Beginner Become An Energy Healer Level 1
courses.description: An eleven-day audio course with a booklet and certificate, introducing how to give an energy session in person or at a distance. It also covers caring for and protecting your own energy field.

courses.title: Intermediate Become An Energy Healer Level 2
courses.description: The second audio course in the series, focused on growing intuition so you can read the energy body and pass on guidance. Practice extends to plants, animals and crystals as well as people.

courses.title: Advanced Become An Energy Healer Level 3
courses.description: The final audio course in the series, applying energy work to places, buildings and businesses. It closes with help shaping your own professional offering as a practitioner.

courses.title: Channeling 101 audio course
courses.description: A ten-day downloadable course on making contact with your higher self, guides and ancestors, with two practice meditations. It sets out simple safety guidelines and ends with you leading a channelling session of your own.

courses.title: Become Your Own Master Creator
courses.description: An audio course on working with the law of attraction to shape the life you want. It includes practices for clearing old patterns and attuning to what you hope to draw in.

courses.title: Magical Money Manifestation
courses.description: A short audio course that treats money as a form of energy shaped by thought, feeling and belief. It offers practices for building a more open relationship with abundance.

courses.title: The Intuitive Advantage: Make Impactful & Rewarding Business Decisions
courses.description: A seventeen-day Insight Timer course for business owners who want to bring intuition into their decisions. It uses meditation, body awareness, heart and third-eye practices and a pendulum.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Carrie Suwal on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided chakra and moon meditations, channelled talks and Reiki-infused tracks, plus several longer courses. The single tracks are free to hear.
